content.text: Intent

Maintain a register of legal entities: the organisations the firm identifies by an LEI (Legal Entity Identifier, the 20-character ISO 17442 code). It gives operations one place to create, review and retire legal entities, so that no free-text counterparty names are needed elsewhere (FCY standing rule R7, company corpus). A legal entity has a status: draft | active | retired.
Scope
IN: the LegalEntity register (name, LEI, status) and its screen.
IN: excluding retired legal entities from selection for new business.
OUT: attributes beyond name, LEI and status (country, parent entity, entity type).
OUT: agreements, accounts, natural persons and trades that refer to a legal entity.
OUT: validating an LEI against the GLEIF registry.
Scenarios
None — keeping the bean's rows through its screen.
Requirements
R1: WHILE a legal entity's status is retired, the system SHALL exclude it from selection for new business and keep it on record.
